title: This Chinese EV Is Now Faster Than Any Bugatti #shorts

scenes.text: An electric car just went faster than any Bugatti. Five hundred and three kilometers per hour.
Since twenty nineteen, the king was a gas Bugatti Chiron. Four hundred ninety.
Last year, BYD's Yangwang U9 Xtreme hit four ninety-six, then the driver lifted off.
So on November first, Abu Dhabi closed a highway. Five oh three point one seven, recognized by the FIA. Three hundred twelve miles per hour.
The secret? Four motors, each up to thirty thousand rpm. Over three thousand horsepower, almost double the Bugatti.
On twelve hundred volts, ten times your wall outlet, so less current and heat. Only thirty will be built.
Genius, or pointless? Who beats it next? Follow EV Drive.
